Chi Square test wrapper for ctsem fit objects.

Source: R/ctCompare.R
ctChisqTest.Rd

The p-value of a likelihood-ratio test between two nested model fits, from either backend. anova(fit1, fit2) gives the whole test: each fit's log likelihood, the chi-square statistic, its degrees of freedom and the p-value.

Usage

ctChisqTest(fit1, fit2)

Arguments

fit1

One of the fits to be compared.

fit2

Second fit to be compared. The fit with more parameters is tested against the other, whichever order they come in.

Value

The p-value: that of the fit with more parameters in anova(fit1, fit2). NA where the two have the same number of parameters.

Examples

# \donttest{
    df <- data.frame(id=1, time=1:length(sunspot.year), Y1=sunspot.year)

    m1 <- ctModel(type='dt', LAMBDA=diag(1),MANIFESTVAR=0)
    m2 <- ctModel(type='dt', LAMBDA=diag(1),MANIFESTVAR=0,DRIFT = .9)

    if (isTRUE(ctJuliaStatus()$available)) {
      f1 <- ctFit(df,m1,cores=1)
      f2 <- ctFit(df,m2,cores=1)

      ctChisqTest(f1,f2)
    }
# }
